highlights: Yesido M-G-02 gun massager is manufactured with 15 watt motor in dimensions of 50 x 135 x 120 mm and weighs 342 grams.
The relatively low weight of this device helps to control comfortably and prevent fatigue during work.
The minimal appearance and the use of different designs in the design of this device make it even more beautiful.

Massage therapy is a popular way to relieve muscle pain, and there's nothing more enjoyable than a great massage after a long, hectic day at work or sports.

Maybe many of us do not have enough time or budget to regularly attend professional massage sessions, but now with the introduction of gun massagers in the market, we can easily and at a much lower cost take advantage of this treatment method.
Features: - Yesido Massage Gun M-G-02 series
Round series: can be used for shoulder, neck and large parts of the bod
Bed series: suitable for relaxation of all parts of the body
Conical series: for joints that have cramps or localized pain
U series: suitable for parts such as neck, shoulder, spine and heel The best and most professional massage therapists use percussion movements to relieve muscle pain and relax you.
